name: Platinic-Scree
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by tectonic rift valleys. Beyond magnetic pole anomalies, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
